item_title: Post-Test C Task 1: Product of First N Integers
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা ১ থেকে N পর্যন্ত সমস্ত সংখ্যার গুণফল লুপ ব্যবহার করে নির্ণয় করবে। (Write a C program to calculate the product of numbers 1 to N). ইনপুট: একটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা N (1 ≤ N ≤ 12)। আউটপুট: ঠিক একটি লাইন — 'Product = 120' (N = 5 হলে); কোনো প্রম্পট বা বাড়তি লেখা ছাপানো যাবে না। (Input: one integer N, 1 ≤ N ≤ 12. Output exactly one line: Product = 120 for N = 5. Print no prompt text.)
teacher_comment: Good loop-and-accumulator task. Limiting N to 12 avoids int overflow, so every correct program gives the same answer, and the sample N=5 giving 120 is very helpful. Students who start the product at 0 will clearly fail, so it tests an important idea. Suitable for the post-test as it stands.

item_title: Post-Test MCQ 2: Domain Name System (DNS) Role
item_question: ডোমেইন নেম সিস্টেম (DNS)-এর প্রধান কাজ কোনটি? (Primary role of Domain Name System DNS).
teacher_comment: Option C is the correct role of DNS and the other options describe unrelated things (database link, file transfer, HTML editing), so the item is unambiguous. Bilingual option text is clear. It is a straight recall question and easy for class 11-12.

item_title: Pre-Test C Task 1: Sum of First N Natural Numbers
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা ১ থেকে N পর্যন্ত সমস্ত ধনাত্মক পূর্ণসংখ্যার যোগফল লুপের মাধ্যমে নির্ণয় করে প্রিন্ট করবে। (Write a C program to calculate the sum of numbers from 1 to N using a loop). ইনপুট: একটি লাইনে একটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা N (1 ≤ N ≤ 1000)। আউটপুট: ঠিক একটি লাইন — Sum = 15 (যখন N = 5)। "Enter N: " জাতীয় কোনো প্রম্পট প্রিন্ট করা যাবে না, শুধু ফলাফলের লাইনটি। (Input: one integer N. Output exactly one line: Sum = 15. Print no prompt text, only the result line.)
teacher_comment: Trace Tutor has a promising approach to helping HSC students understand programming through step-by-step explanations. Its connection to the HSC ICT curriculum gives the platform a clear purpose and makes it relevant to classroom learning. I particularly like the emphasis on understanding how a solution works, which could encourage students to think more carefully about their code. Simpler wording and shorter explanations would make the content easier for beginners to follow. More examples of common mistakes and how to correct them could also make practice more useful. The difficulty should increase gradually so that students have time to build confidence with the basics. Encouraging students to attempt each problem before revealing a complete solution would create more opportunities for independent thinking. With continued teacher input and feedback from students, TRACE Tutor could become a useful companion to regular classroom teaching.

item_title: Transfer Task 4: Average of Three Float Numbers
item_question: তিনটি দশমিক সংখ্যার (Float Numbers) গড় (Average) নির্ণয় করার জন্য একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন। (Calculate average of 3 float numbers). ইনপুট: এক লাইনে স্পেস দিয়ে আলাদা করা তিনটি দশমিক সংখ্যা। আউটপুট: দুই দশমিক ঘর পর্যন্ত ঠিক এই ফরম্যাটে একটিমাত্র লাইন — 10 20 30 হলে Average = 20.00। কোনো প্রম্পট নয়। (Input: three float numbers separated by spaces on one line. Output exactly one line rounded to 2 decimal places: Average = 20.00 for 10 20 30. No prompt.)
teacher_comment: Reasonable transfer from sum to average, and the sample 10 20 30 giving 20.00 is clear. The starter declares float, but float can give rounding differences for some inputs, so I suggest accepting double also. The Bangla wording is fine but long. Medium difficulty.

item_title: Transfer MCQ 5: Text Formatting Emphasis Tag
item_question: এইচটিএমএল-এ টেক্সটকে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ জোর (Emphasis) দেওয়ার জন্য কোন ট্যাগটি ব্যবহৃত হয়? (Emphasis tag <em>).
teacher_comment: Em is the textbook answer, but the item has a defensibility problem: i is also commonly used for emphasis by students and many books treat it as italic emphasis, so a good student may argue for C. Bold is invalid and mark is highlight only. Consider asking 'semantic emphasis' in the stem.

item_title: Withdrawal HTML Task 2: Image Gallery Grid with Alt Text
item_question: এইচটিএমএল (HTML) ব্যবহার করে বিকল্প টেক্সটসহ (alt="Book Cover") ২ টি বইয়ের ছবির গ্রিড তৈরি করুন। (Image grid with alt text). ২টি ট্যাগ লিখুন, প্রতিটিতে src ও alt থাকবে এবং অন্তত একটির alt="Book Cover"। (Write 2 tags, each with a src and an alt; at least one alt="Book Cover".)
teacher_comment: A fair withdrawal task for the img tag, with src and alt both required and at least one alt 'Book Cover'. The word 'grid' in the title is misleading because only two img tags are asked and no layout is checked. Otherwise clear, correct and aligned with the accessibility point in the chapter.

item_title: Post-Test C Task 2: Positive or Negative Checker
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা প্রদত্ত সংখ্যাটি ধনাত্মক (Positive) নাকি ঋণাত্মক (Negative) তা if-else দিয়ে পরীক্ষা করবে। (Check positive or negative number). ইনপুট: একটি শূন্য-নয় (non-zero) পূর্ণসংখ্যা num। আউটপুট: ঠিক একটি লাইন — num > 0 হলে 'Positive', নতুবা 'Negative'; কোনো প্রম্পট বা বাড়তি লেখা ছাপানো যাবে না। (Input: one non-zero integer num. Output exactly one line: Positive if num > 0, otherwise Negative. Print no prompt text.)
teacher_comment: Simple but clean if-else exercise. Stating that the input is a non-zero integer removes the zero ambiguity, and 'positive if num>0 otherwise Negative' leaves one correct logic. A good check for boundary values like 1 and -1, though it is easy for HSC.

item_title: Post-Test MCQ 3: Character Encoding Meta Tag
item_question: বাংলা ভাষা ও আন্তর্জাতিক অক্ষরের সঠিক রূপায়নের জন্য এইচটিএমএল-এ কোন চারসেট মেটা ট্যাগ যুক্ত করা হয়? (Character encoding meta tag for Bengali UTF-8).
teacher_comment: B is correct, charset UTF-8 handles Bengali. The distractors are believable but invalid or wrong, like meta type UNICODE and meta encoding, so students must really know the attribute. Question text is clear and the curriculum link to Chapter 4 is good.

item_title: Pre-Test HTML Task 3: Formatted Ordered List
item_question: এইচটিএমএল (HTML) ব্যবহার করে ১, ২, ৩ ক্রমিক নম্বরযুক্ত একটি Ordered List (<ol>) তৈরি করুন যেখানে বিষয়গুলোর নাম বোল্ড (<b>) হবে। (Formatted ordered list). তালিকায় ঠিক তিনটি <li> আইটেম থাকবে — ক্রমানুসারে Bangla, English, ICT (নামগুলো ইংরেজিতেই লিখুন) — এবং প্রতিটি নাম <b> ট্যাগ দিয়ে বোল্ড করতে হবে। (Exactly three <li> items in this order — Bangla, English, ICT — each name wrapped in a <b> tag.)
teacher_comment: Task is clear: three items in order Bangla, English, ICT with each name inside b. Fits the list section of Chapter 4. Technically the b tag is only presentational and modern practice prefers strong, but since the textbook uses b it is fine. A simple recall-level task, easy for class 11-12.

item_title: Transfer Task 5: Armstrong Number Verification
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা ৩ অংকের সংখ্যা আর্মস্ট্রং সংখ্যা (Armstrong Number: 153 = 1^3+5^3+3^3) কিনা তা পরীক্ষা করবে। (Check Armstrong number). ইনপুট: একটি ৩ অংকের পূর্ণসংখ্যা N। আউটপুট: আর্মস্ট্রং হলে ঠিক Armstrong Number, না হলে ঠিক Ordinary Number — একটিমাত্র লাইন, কোনো প্রম্পট নয়। (Input: one 3-digit integer N. Output exactly Armstrong Number or Ordinary Number on a single line, no prompt.)
teacher_comment: A strong transfer problem needing digit extraction with modulus and division plus cubing three digits. It limits the input to three digits, which keeps it answerable at HSC level. Phrase 'ঠিক Armstrong Number' is slightly heavy; also say that pow() is not required, since cubing by multiplication works.

item_title: Transfer MCQ 6: Relational Cardinalities
item_question: একজন শিক্ষকের অধীনে একাধিক শিক্ষার্থী থাকার সম্পর্ককে কোন রিলেশনশিপ বলা হয়? (One-to-Many cardinality).
teacher_comment: The one-teacher-many-students example gives One-to-Many without doubt, and Many-to-Many is a good tempting option. Self Relationship is an unusual distractor that most students will ignore. Reasonable difficulty for the DBMS chapter, though the phrase 'রিলেশনশিপ' mixes languages.

item_title: Post-Test C Task 3: Fibonacci Series Term Calculation
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা ফিবোনাক্কি সিরিজের N-তম পদ নির্ণয় করে প্রদর্শন করবে (F0=0, F1=1)। (Calculate Nth Fibonacci number). ইনপুট: একটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা N (0 ≤ N ≤ 40)। আউটপুট: ঠিক একটি লাইন — 'Fibonacci = 13' (N = 7 হলে); কোনো প্রম্পট বা বাড়তি লেখা ছাপানো যাবে না। (Input: one integer N, 0 ≤ N ≤ 40. Output exactly one line: Fibonacci = 13 for N = 7. Print no prompt text.)
teacher_comment: Well-built item. F0=0 and F1=1 are given, the range 0 to 40 avoids overflow, and the sample N=7 giving 13 lets students check themselves. It needs a loop and variable shifting, so it tests real logic. I find it suitable for the post-test with no changes.

item_title: Post-Test MCQ 4: Table Header Cell Tag
item_question: এইচটিএমএল টেবিলে কলামের শিরোনাম বা হেডার তৈরির জন্য কোন ট্যাগ ব্যবহৃত হয়? (Table header element tag).
teacher_comment: Th is the correct header cell tag and the book page agrees. Option B is typed as '<tr >' with a stray space, which looks like a typing mistake and should be fixed. Header is a plausible distractor for students who think of page headers. Recall level, quite easy.

item_title: Pre-Test MCQ 1: HTML Hyperlink Anchor Tag
item_question: এইচটিএমএল (HTML) ডকুমেন্টে অন্য কোনো ওয়েব পেজ হাইপারলিংক করার জন্য কোন ট্যাগটি ব্যবহৃত হয়? (Which tag creates a hyperlink in HTML?)
teacher_comment: The anchor tag is the right answer and matches the hyperlink topic. Small design flaw: option C shows the href attribute while the others are bare tags, so the correct option stands out and weaker students can pick it by form alone. Easy for class 11-12 but acceptable as a pre-test opener.

item_title: Transfer HTML Task 1: Student Registration Form
item_question: নাম ইনপুট টেক্সট বক্স এবং সাবমিট বাটনসহ একটি এইচটিএমএল ফর্ম (<form>) তৈরি করার কোড লিখুন। (Student registration HTML form). ফর্মের ভেতরে থাকতে হবে: Name লেখা একটি <label>, name="name" সহ একটি <input type="text">, এবং একটি <input type="submit">। (Inside the form: a <label> reading Name, an <input type="text"> with name="name", and an <input type="submit">.)
teacher_comment: Fair form task, but the statement insists on an input of type submit, while many students naturally use a button element and may lose marks even though the form works. Either state that a button is not accepted or allow both. The for/name requirements are clear. Medium difficulty.

item_title: Transfer MCQ 7: SQL UPDATE Command
item_question: ডাটাবেজ টেবিলের বিদ্যমান ডেটা সংশোধন করার জন্য কোন এসকিউএল (SQL) কমান্ড ব্যবহৃত হয়? (SQL UPDATE command).
teacher_comment: UPDATE is the correct command for changing existing records. ALTER is a strong distractor because it changes table structure, and MODIFY sounds right but is not a standalone command, so the item has good discrimination. Matches the SQL page cited and wording is clear.

item_title: Withdrawal MCQ 1: Web Server vs Browser Roles
item_question: ওয়েব পেজ প্রদর্শনকারী ক্লায়েন্ট-সাইড সফটওয়্যার কোনটি? (Client-side web browser).
teacher_comment: Web browser is the client-side software, and the other three are server or database technologies, so there is no confusion. Nicely connected to the client-server idea in Chapter 4. A very easy question for this level, so it works best as a confidence builder in the withdrawal set.

item_title: Post-Test C Task 4: Minimum of Three Numbers
item_question: তিনটি পূর্ণসংখ্যার মধ্যে ক্ষুদ্রতম সংখ্যাটি (Minimum) নির্ণয় করার জন্য একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন। (Find minimum of three numbers). ইনপুট: এক লাইনে স্পেস দিয়ে আলাদা করা তিনটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা a b c। আউটপুট: ঠিক একটি লাইন — 'Minimum = 7' (ইনপুট 12 7 25 হলে); কোনো প্রম্পট বা বাড়তি লেখা ছাপানো যাবে না। (Input: three space-separated integers a b c on one line. Output exactly one line: Minimum = 7 for the input 12 7 25. Print no prompt text.)
teacher_comment: Straightforward conditional task with a clear sample (12 7 25 gives 7). A student can solve it with if-else or a running minimum, so it is fair. The Bangla instruction is long and mixes English, but still understandable. Medium difficulty and matches Chapter 5.

item_title: Post-Test MCQ 5: Anchor Target Attribute
item_question: হাইপারলিংকে ক্লিক করলে লিংকটি নতুন ব্রাউজার ট্যাবে খুলতে কোন target অ্যাট্রিবিউট ব্যবহার করা হয়? (Target attribute for new tab).
teacher_comment: Answer is _blank, but option C (_new) is a risky distractor: many browsers do open a new tab for _new because it is treated as a window name, so a strong student could defend it. The question would be safer with 'standard value' in the stem. Curriculum fit is good.

item_title: Pre-Test MCQ 2: Secure Web Protocol & Default Port
item_question: নিরাপদ ওয়েব ডেটা আদান-প্রদানের জন্য কোন প্রোটোকল এবং পোর্ট নম্বর ব্যবহৃত হয়? (Secure protocol & port).
teacher_comment: HTTPS on port 443 is the correct pair and the other options are real protocols with their own ports, which is a good design. The question asks both protocol and port at once, which is a bit wordy. It is basic recall, easy for class 11-12, but a fair pre-test starter.

item_title: Transfer HTML Task 2: Embedded Video Player
item_question: একটি ভিডিও ফাইল প্লে করার জন্য এইচটিএমএল৫ (<video>) কন্ট্রোলসহ কোড স্ট্রাকচার লিখুন। (Embedded HTML5 video player). একটিমাত্র <video> ট্যাগে controls, width ও height অ্যাট্রিবিউট দিন এবং তার ভেতরে type="video/mp4" সহ একটি <source src="..."> রাখুন। (Use exactly one <video> with controls, width and height, containing one <source src="..." type="video/mp4">.)
teacher_comment: Good task covering controls, width, height and the source type. The checker needs to accept any file name in src because the statement does not give one. The phrase 'exactly one video tag' is clear. Moderate difficulty, suitable for the transfer set.

item_title: Withdrawal C Task 1: Sum of Odd Numbers 1 to N
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা ১ থেকে N পর্যন্ত সমস্ত বিজোড় পূর্ণসংখ্যার যোগফল লুপের মাধ্যমে নির্ণয় করবে। (Sum of odd numbers from 1 to N). ইনপুট: একটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা N। আউটপুট: কোনো প্রম্পট বা বাড়তি লেখা ছাড়া শুধু একটি লাইন — ঠিক এই ফরম্যাটে 'Sum = 25' (N = 9 হলে)। (Input: one integer N. Output: exactly one line and nothing else, no prompt — Sum = 25 for N = 9.)
teacher_comment: Nice loop exercise, and the sample N=9 giving 25 helps students verify the stepping idea. Students who add every number will fail, so the item separates understanding from copying. Wording is clean and the output format is exact. Right level for HSC.

item_title: Withdrawal MCQ 2: Absolute vs Relative URL Syntax
item_question: সম্পূর্ণ প্রোটোকল ও ডোমেইন সহ ওয়েবসাইট ঠিকানা (যেমন: https://site.com/page.html) কে কি বলা হয়? (Absolute URL vs Relative URL).
teacher_comment: Absolute URL is the right answer and the example https://site.com/page.html supports it. Static IP and Local Host are unrelated, so guessing is not hard. The concept is straight from the textbook, clear but too easy for the withdrawal stage.

item_title: Post-Test HTML Task 1: Employee Table with Rowspan
item_question: একটি HTML টেবিল তৈরি করুন যেখানে "Department" সেলটি ২ টি সারি জুড়ে সম্প্রসারিত (rowspan="2") থাকবে। (Create HTML table with rowspan="2"). টেবিলে অন্তত দুইটি সারি (<tr>) থাকবে; rowspan="2" দেওয়া সেলটিতে "Department" লেখা থাকবে এবং বাকি দুইটি সেলে দুইজন কর্মীর নাম Rahim ও Karim থাকবে। (The table has at least two rows: the cell carrying rowspan="2" holds the text Department, and the two remaining cells hold the employee names Rahim and Karim.)
teacher_comment: Practical item that checks rowspan placement. My concern is the stem: it says the two remaining cells hold Rahim and Karim but does not say whether the rowspan cell should be th or td, so a student using th might be marked down unfairly. The checker should accept either.

item_title: Post-Test MCQ 7: SQL Conditional WHERE Clause
item_question: এসকিউএল (SQL) কোয়েরিতে নির্দিষ্ট শর্ত আরোপ করে ডেটা ফিল্টার করতে কোন ক্লজ ব্যবহার করা হয়? (Conditional WHERE clause in SQL).
teacher_comment: WHERE is the correct filter clause and matches the SQL page cited. HAVING is also a condition, but it is used with GROUP BY, so a strong student may hesitate; I would add 'on individual rows' to the stem. Otherwise a quick recall question, a bit easy for class 11-12.

item_title: Pre-Test MCQ 4: HTML Table Column Spanning Attribute
item_question: এইচটিএমএল (HTML) টেবিলে একাধিক কলামকে একসাথে যুক্ত করার জন্য কোন অ্যাট্রিবিউট ব্যবহৃত হয়? (Attribute to span multiple columns).
teacher_comment: Colspan is the right answer and sits squarely in the table section of Chapter 4. The rowspan option is a good distractor because students often mix the two, so the item separates those who really know the attributes. Cellpadding and cellspacing are fair wrong options. Clear stem.

item_title: Transfer MCQ 1: External CSS Linking Tag
item_question: এইচটিএমএল ডকুমেন্টের সাথে বাহ্যিক সিএসএস (External CSS) ফাইল যুক্ত করার জন্য কোন ট্যাগটি সঠিক? (External CSS linking tag).
teacher_comment: Very good question. All four options look like believable tags but only link with rel=stylesheet is valid, so students have to really know the syntax and cannot guess. Matches the CSS linking topic in the book and the Bangla wording is crisp. Right level for HSC.

item_title: Withdrawal C Task 3: Power Calculation (X^Y)
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা কোনো ভিত্তি সংখ্যা X এবং পাওয়ার Y গ্রহণ করে X^Y মান নির্ণয় করবে। (Calculate power X^Y). ইনপুট: এক লাইনে ফাঁকা স্থান দিয়ে আলাদা করা দুটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা X ও Y। আউটপুট: কোনো প্রম্পট ছাড়া ঠিক একটি লাইন — ঠিক এই ফরম্যাটে 'Result = 8' (X = 2, Y = 3 হলে)। (Input: two space-separated integers X and Y on one line. Output: exactly one line, no prompt — Result = 8 for X = 2, Y = 3.)
teacher_comment: Good loop-based transfer from the multiplication idea. Sample (2 and 3 gives 8) is clear. Two issues: the starter names a variable exp, which clashes with the math function if a student includes math.h, and the stem is silent on Y=0 or large values that overflow int.

item_title: Withdrawal MCQ 4: Table Cellpadding Attribute
item_question: টেবিল সেলের বর্ডার এবং কনটেন্টের মধ্যকার দূরত্ব নিয়ন্ত্রণ করতে কোন অ্যাট্রিবিউট ব্যবহৃত হয়? (Table cellpadding attribute).
teacher_comment: Cellpadding is the answer the textbook gives, and margin is a tempting wrong choice. Technically though, cellpadding is an obsolete HTML attribute replaced by CSS padding, so the item tests older syntax. Clear wording but low difficulty for this level.

item_title: Post-Test HTML Task 2: Internal Section Bookmark Link
item_question: একই ওয়েব পেজের `#contact` আইডি বিশিষ্ট সেকশনে নেভিগেট করার জন্য একটি এইচটিএমএল হাইপারলিংক লিখুন। (Internal section bookmark hyperlink). হাইপারলিংকের লেখা হবে "Contact", এবং একই পেজে id="contact" সহ একটি সেকশন থাকবে যার শিরোনামেও "Contact" লেখা থাকবে। (The link text is Contact, and the same page contains a section with id="contact" whose heading also reads Contact.)
teacher_comment: Good practical task that tests the fragment link and the matching id together. My concern is wording: the stem has the id written in backticks and says the heading 'also reads Contact' without saying which heading tag to use. A student using h1 or h3 should not lose marks, so the checker must be flexible.

item_title: Pre-Test MCQ 5: Image Source Attribute
item_question: ওয়েব পেজে ছবি প্রদর্শনের জন্য ট্যাগের সাথে অপরিহার্য কোন অ্যাট্রিবিউটটি ফাইলের পথ নির্দেশ করে? (Image source attribute).
teacher_comment: The src attribute is the correct answer and the question stays on the textbook image-tag topic. Alt is a good distractor because it is also commonly written with img, and href tempts students who mix up links and images. Very basic though, more of a warm-up than a Grade 11-12 challenge.

item_title: Transfer Task 1: Sum of Squares of First N Numbers
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা ১^২ + ২^২ + ... + N^২ গাণিতিক ধারার যোগফল নির্ণয় করে প্রিন্ট করবে। (Calculate sum of series 1^2 + 2^2 + ... + N^2). ইনপুট: একটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা N। আউটপুট: ঠিক এই ফরম্যাটে একটিমাত্র লাইন — N = 5 হলে Sum = 55। কোনো প্রম্পট বা বাড়তি লেখা প্রিন্ট করা যাবে না। (Input: one integer N. Output exactly one line: Sum = 55 when N = 5. Print no prompt text.)
teacher_comment: A good transfer from a simple loop to a series, and the worked example N=5 giving 55 makes the expected format very clear. I would mention a limit for N, because a large N overflows int and the answer then depends on data type, which is not part of the lesson.

item_title: Transfer MCQ 2: Dynamic Website Characteristic
item_question: ডাইনামিক ওয়েবসাইটের (Dynamic Website) প্রধান বৈশিষ্ট্য কোনটি? (Dynamic website characteristics).
teacher_comment: Option B is the accepted answer from the textbook, and C and D are clearly wrong. However, a dynamic site does not strictly need a database, since JavaScript can change content too, so 'database attached' is slightly narrow technically. Fine for HSC level but easy.

item_title: Withdrawal C Task 4: Swap Two Numbers Using Variable
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা একটি অস্থায়ী চলক (Temporary Variable) ব্যবহার করে ২টির ইন্টারচেঞ্জ বা সোয়াপ (Swap) করবে। (Swap two variables). ইনপুট: এক লাইনে ফাঁকা স্থান দিয়ে আলাদা করা দুটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা a ও b। আউটপুট: সোয়াপের পর কোনো প্রম্পট ছাড়া ঠিক একটি লাইন — ঠিক এই ফরম্যাটে 'After swap: 7 3' (a = 3, b = 7 হলে)। (Input: two space-separated integers a and b. Output: exactly one line after swapping — After swap: 7 3 for a = 3, b = 7.)
teacher_comment: Swap with a temporary variable is the right Chapter 5 idea and the sample output (3 7 gives 7 3) is unambiguous. One weakness: the task demands a temp variable but an auto-checker only sees the output, so a student who swaps without temp still passes. Clarity of the Bangla instruction is acceptable.

item_title: Withdrawal MCQ 5: Target Attribute Default Value
item_question: লিংক ট্যাগে target অ্যাট্রিবিউট না দিলে ডিফল্টভাবে লিংকটি কোথায় ওপেন হয়? (Default target attribute value _self).
teacher_comment: Correct answer is B, the _self default, which matches the HTML chapter. Distractors like _blank and the pop-up box are believable, so students who only guess will be caught. Well-worded, moderate recall level, and a fair question for the withdrawal set.

item_title: Pre-Test C Task 1: Sum of First N Natural Numbers
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা ১ থেকে N পর্যন্ত সমস্ত ধনাত্মক পূর্ণসংখ্যার যোগফল লুপের মাধ্যমে নির্ণয় করে প্রিন্ট করবে। (Write a C program to calculate the sum of numbers from 1 to N using a loop). ইনপুট: একটি লাইনে একটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা N (1 ≤ N ≤ 1000)। আউটপুট: ঠিক একটি লাইন — Sum = 15 (যখন N = 5)। "Enter N: " জাতীয় কোনো প্রম্পট প্রিন্ট করা যাবে না, শুধু ফলাফলের লাইনটি। (Input: one integer N. Output exactly one line: Sum = 15. Print no prompt text, only the result line.)
teacher_comment: Well-structured pre-test problem aligned with NCTB HSC ICT Chapter 5. The bilingual prompt, input constraints ($1 \le N \le 1000$ preventing integer overflow), starter code, and strict output format (Sum = 15) are unambiguous and ideal for automated grading at the Grade 11–12 level.

item_title: Pre-Test C Task 2: Even or Odd Number Verification
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা প্রদত্ত সংখ্যাটি জোড় (Even) নাকি বিজোড় (Odd) তা মডুলাস (%) অপারেটর দিয়ে পরীক্ষা করবে। (Check if a given number is even or odd). ইনপুট: একটি লাইনে একটি অঋণাত্মক পূর্ণসংখ্যা N। আউটপুট: ঠিক একটি লাইন — জোড় হলে Even, বিজোড় হলে Odd। কোনো প্রম্পট বা বাড়তি লেখা প্রিন্ট করা যাবে না, শুধু ফলাফলের লাইনটি। (Input: one non-negative integer N. Output exactly one line: Even or Odd. Print no prompt text, only the result line.)
teacher_comment: Highly suitable for Grade 11–12 NCTB ICT Chapter 5. The prompt clearly mandates the modulus operator (%) for even/odd checking, includes clean starter code, and defines strict output formatting (Even or Odd) for automated assessment.

item_title: Pre-Test C Task 3: Factorial of a Positive Integer
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা ব্যবহারকারীর প্রদত্ত ধনাত্মক সংখ্যা N-এর ফ্যাক্টোরিয়াল (N!) নির্ণয় করবে। (Calculate factorial N!). ইনপুট: একটি লাইনে একটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা N (0 ≤ N ≤ 12)। আউটপুট: ঠিক একটি লাইন — Factorial = 120 (যখন N = 5); মনে রাখবেন 0! = 1। কোনো প্রম্পট প্রিন্ট করা যাবে না, শুধু ফলাফলের লাইনটি। (Input: one integer N, 0 ≤ N ≤ 12. Output exactly one line: Factorial = 120. Note 0! = 1. Print no prompt text.)
teacher_comment: একাদশ-দ্বাদশ শ্রেণির NCTB ICT ৫ম অধ্যায়ের জন্য এটি একটি অত্যন্ত মানসম্মত ও উপযোগী প্রি-টেস্ট সমস্যা। ইনপুট সীমার ($0 \le N \le 12$) উল্লেখ থাকায় ইন্টিজার ওভারফ্লো এড়ানো সম্ভব হয়েছে, এবং $0! = 1$-এর বিশেষ কেসসহ সঠিক আউটপুট ফরম্যাট (Factorial = 120) অটোমেটেড মূল্যায়নের জন্য অত্যন্ত স্পষ্ট।

item_title: Pre-Test C Task 4: Maximum of Three Numbers
item_question: তিনটি সংখ্যার মধ্যে বৃহত্তম সংখ্যাটি নির্ণয় করার জন্য একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন। (Find maximum of three numbers). ইনপুট: একটি লাইনে স্পেস দিয়ে আলাদা করা তিনটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা a b c। আউটপুট: ঠিক একটি লাইন — Max = 9 (যখন ইনপুট 3 9 5)। কোনো প্রম্পট প্রিন্ট করা যাবে না, শুধু ফলাফলের লাইনটি। (Input: three space-separated integers a b c on one line. Output exactly one line: Max = 9. Print no prompt text.)
teacher_comment: An excellent pre-test question aligned with NCTB ICT Chapter 5. The input format (three space-separated integers), starter code, and strict output format (Max = 9) are crystal clear and perfectly suited for automated testing of conditional logic at the HSC level.

item_title: Pre-Test C Task 5: Prime Number Verification
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা কোনো প্রদত্ত পূর্ণসংখ্যা মৌলিক সংখ্যা (Prime Number) কিনা তা পরীক্ষা করে দেখাবে। (Verify prime number). ইনপুট: একটি লাইনে একটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা N (N ≥ 1)। আউটপুট: ঠিক একটি লাইন — প্রথমে N, তারপর মৌলিক হলে is Prime, না হলে is Not Prime; যেমন 7 is Prime বা 9 is Not Prime। মনে রাখবেন 1 মৌলিক সংখ্যা নয়। কোনো প্রম্পট প্রিন্ট করা যাবে না। (Input: one integer N ≥ 1. Output exactly one line: "7 is Prime" or "9 is Not Prime". 1 is not prime. Print no prompt text.)
teacher_comment: একাদশ-দ্বাদশ শ্রেণির NCTB ICT ৫ম অধ্যায়ের জন্য এটি একটি চমৎকার ও মানসম্মত প্রি-টেস্ট সমস্যা। ইনপুট শর্ত ($N \ge 1$), ১ মৌলিক সংখ্যা নয়—এই বিশেষ নিয়ম এবং নির্দিষ্ট আউটপুট ফরম্যাট (7 is Prime / 9 is Not Prime) অটোমেটেড গ্রেডিং ও লজিক্যাল মূল্যায়নের জন্য অত্যন্ত স্পষ্ট।

item_title: Pre-Test HTML Task 1: Student Marks Table Structure
item_question: একটি এইচটিএমএল (HTML) কোড লিখুন যা ২ সারি ও ২ কলামের একটি টেবিল তৈরি করবে (Roll ও Marks হেডারসহ)। (Create a 2x2 table for Roll and Marks). প্রথম সারিতে <th> দিয়ে Roll ও Marks হেডার দুটি এবং দ্বিতীয় সারিতে <td> দিয়ে একজন শিক্ষার্থীর রোল ও নম্বর লিখুন — মোট ২টি সারি, প্রতি সারিতে ২টি সেল। (First row: two <th> cells reading Roll and Marks; second row: two <td> cells holding one student's roll and marks — 2 rows, 2 cells each.)
teacher_comment: An excellent pre-test question aligned with NCTB ICT Chapter 4. Clear structural guidelines for creating a 2x2 table using <table>, <tr>, <th>, and <td> make it ideal for assessing basic HTML table skills at the HSC level.

item_title: Pre-Test HTML Task 2: Clickable Image Hyperlink
item_question: এমন একটি HTML কোড লিখুন যেখানে "college.jpg" ছবিটিতে ক্লিক করলে "https://nctb.gov.bd" ওয়েবসাইটটি ওপেন হবে। (Clickable image hyperlink). ঠিক একটি ট্যাগ ব্যবহার করুন যার href="https://nctb.gov.bd", এবং ট্যাগটি সেই ট্যাগের ভিতরে রাখুন। (Use exactly one tag with href="https://nctb.gov.bd" and place inside that anchor.)
teacher_comment: Perfectly targets the multimedia integration competencies outlined in NCTB Chapter 4, specifically evaluating proper anchor-image nesting and URL attribute handling.

item_title: Transfer Task 4: Average of Three Float Numbers
item_question: তিনটি দশমিক সংখ্যার (Float Numbers) গড় (Average) নির্ণয় করার জন্য একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন। (Calculate average of 3 float numbers). ইনপুট: এক লাইনে স্পেস দিয়ে আলাদা করা তিনটি দশমিক সংখ্যা। আউটপুট: দুই দশমিক ঘর পর্যন্ত ঠিক এই ফরম্যাটে একটিমাত্র লাইন — 10 20 30 হলে Average = 20.00। কোনো প্রম্পট নয়। (Input: three float numbers separated by spaces on one line. Output exactly one line rounded to 2 decimal places: Average = 20.00 for 10 20 30. No prompt.)
teacher_comment: Trace tutor is an effective platform to help HSC students to improve their learning capability, including the practical part also. Natural language would help students to track the system in a better way.

item_question: এইচটিএমএল (HTML) ব্যবহার করে ডিস্ক (disc) স্টাইলের বুলেটযুক্ত একটি Unordered List (<ul>) তৈরি করুন। (Create unordered bullet list). তালিকাটি <ul type="disc"> দিয়ে লিখুন এবং তাতে ঠিক তিনটি <li> আইটেম থাকবে — HTML, CSS ও JavaScript। (Write the list as <ul type="disc"> containing exactly three <li> items: HTML, CSS and JavaScript.)
teacher_comment: Task matches the Chapter 4 list topic and the spec is exact: ul type=disc, three li items. Only concern is that the type attribute is deprecated in HTML5, though NCTB still teaches it so I accept it. Very easy for HSC post-test, more of a recall check.

item_title: Pre-Test MCQ 6: Primary Key Characteristic
item_question: ডাটাবেজ ম্যানেজমেন্ট সিস্টেমে (DBMS) প্রাইমারি কি (Primary Key)-এর প্রধান বৈশিষ্ট্য কোনটি? (Primary key characteristic).
teacher_comment: Primary key is a core Chapter 6 idea and option C is the only fully correct one. A and B contradict the definition, D is a plain distractor. Fine as a pre-test item; maybe a tiny bit easy for HSC level, but the Bangla wording is clear.

item_title: Transfer Task 2: Leap Year Verification Algorithm
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা কোনো নির্দিষ্ট বছর লিপ ইয়ার (Leap Year) কিনা তা শর্ত সাপেক্ষে যাচাই করে দেখাবে। (Leap year verification algorithm). ইনপুট: একটি পূর্ণসংখ্যা বছর Y। আউটপুট: লিপ ইয়ার হলে ঠিক Leap Year, না হলে ঠিক Common Year — একটিমাত্র লাইন, কোনো প্রম্পট নয়। (Input: one integer year Y. Output exactly Leap Year or Common Year on a single line, no prompt.)
teacher_comment: Good transfer task, the leap year rule (divisible by 4, not by 100 unless 400) is the right place to use nested if or logical operators. Output format is strictly stated. I would mention the century rule in the statement because a student who only knows the divisible-by-4 rule can't be blamed.

item_title: Transfer MCQ 3: Form Radio Button vs Checkbox
item_question: ফর্মে একাধিক অপশন থেকে যেকোনো একটি মাত্র নির্বাচন করার জন্য কোন ইনপুট টাইপ ব্যবহার করা হয়? (Radio button vs checkbox).
teacher_comment: Correct answer is A (radio) and the distractors are valid input types or a made-up one (select is a tag, not a type). Wording 'যেকোনো একটি' could briefly confuse weaker students with checkbox. Too easy for class 11-12, but fine as a transfer check.

item_title: Withdrawal C Task 5: Palindrome Number Verification
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা কোনো প্রদত্ত পূর্ণসংখ্যা প্যালিনড্রোম (Palindrome: যেমন 121) কিনা তা পরীক্ষা করে দেখাবে। (Verify palindrome number). ইনপুট: একটি ধনাত্মক পূর্ণসংখ্যা N। আউটপুট: কোনো প্রম্পট ছাড়া ঠিক একটি লাইন — প্যালিনড্রোম হলে 'Palindrome = YES', না হলে 'Palindrome = NO'। (Input: one positive integer N. Output: exactly one line, no prompt — Palindrome = YES or Palindrome = NO.)
teacher_comment: Palindrome check is a nice loop and modulus exercise from Chapter 5, and the output strings are clearly fixed. The statement doesn't give an upper limit for N, so overflow of int is unspecified. Edge cases like 10 or 7 would be good test cases.

item_title: Withdrawal MCQ 6: Database Indexing Purpose
item_question: ডাটাবেজ টেবিলে ইনডেক্সিং (Indexing) ব্যবহারের মূল উদ্দেশ্য কোনটি? (Database indexing purpose).
teacher_comment: Option D is clearly right and B is wrong since an index actually costs extra space. Language is clean. However indexing is only briefly touched in the HSC ICT book, so curriculum fit is moderate, and the question is easy for this level.

qualitative_feedback:
You've shown a strong grasp of HTML structure, completing all three HTML tasks perfectly with proper tables, image attributes, and nested lists. Your logic for the GPA evaluator and Palindrome verifications in C was also spot-on.

However, you lost points on the other C programming tasks. Task 1 was left blank. In Task 3 (Power Calculation), your loop condition i < e runs one time too few; change it to i <= e so it multiplies the correct number of times. In Task 4 (Swapping), you tried to swap without a temporary variable by doing a = b; b = a;, which overwrites the value of a before it can be assigned to b. You need to store a in a temp variable first (as the problem requested) like this: temp = a; a = b; b = temp;. Keep practicing those basic algorithms!

Very good work on four C problems, correct and tidy, and the HTML answers are all right including rowspan and the internal link. The divisor counting task was not attempted, which cost you the marks; try to give at least a basic loop attempt next time.

Assigning an independent expert mark of 52/100, this submission demonstrates mixed competence where the automated binary grading penalizes minor oversights harshly. The student shows strong mastery in variable swapping, palindrome verification, and complex HTML table structuring (fully executing Tasks 4, 5, and HTML Task 1), and secures partial credit on the GPA evaluator, image gallery, and navigation bar tasks despite small logical or structural gaps like strict inequalities (marks > 80) and missing tags. However, leaving C Tasks 1 and 3 completely unattempted significantly impacts the overall grade, indicating that time management and completeness remain key areas for improvement.

Sum, factorial, maximum and the prime check up to sqrt are correct, good optimisation. Even/odd test uses n>0, which is not how parity works; use n%2==0. For the marks table the expected header cells (th) are missing. Clickable image link is right, but the ordered list lacks the required formatting.

All five C programs are accurate and well-structured, and using double for the average was a wise choice. Marks lost on HTML: the label needs a for attribute and the input needs name="name". Video and nested list were left blank, so a big part of the web section is missing. Please attempt every question.

Product starts with p=0, so every answer is 0; it must start at 1. The Fibonacci loop runs one time too many (i<=n instead of i<n). Positive/negative, minimum and divisor counter are correct. Tables and bookmark link are right. Disc type is missing from the ul, a small deduction.

Leap year checks only divisibility by 4, so 1900 or 2100 come out wrong. Reverse loop never builds the number, it just keeps the last digit read. Average formula misses brackets around a+b+c. Armstrong needs digit cubed, you squared it. Sum of squares was skipped. Form is fine, but the video has no controls attribute and the list is not nested.

Excellent performance on the C sum/max tasks and HTML table/hyperlink/list structures (10/15 correct, 67% server score). For future improvements, ensure even/odd checks use the modulus operator (n % 2 == 0) rather than checking n > 0, initialize factorial accumulators to 1 instead of 0, implement complete prime verification instead of just checking divisibility by 2, and remember to include the requested formatted ordered list (<ol>) in HTML tasks.

Mostly correct. Positive check uses number>1, so 1 is wrongly called Negative; the condition should be >0. Bookmark link fails because section id is contacts while href is #contact. The rest, product, Fibonacci, minimum, divisors, rowspan table and disc list, are accurate.

Sum and even/odd are right. Factorial begins from 0 so the product is always zero, maximum never compares the third number, and the prime check just tests odd. For HTML the table needs th header cells, though the image link and bold ordered list are correct. Revise initialisation and full comparisons.

You did a fantastic job on this assignment! Your HTML is completely spotless—great work handling the table structure and nested navigation links. On the C programming side, your logic for reversing numbers (Palindrome) and swapping variables is really solid.

I gave you an 88 because you missed just one tiny detail in the Power Calculation problem (Task 3). Take a close look at your loop condition: counter < e. Since you started counting at 1, stopping strictly before e means the loop runs one time too few (so if the power is 3, it only multiplies twice). If you just change that to counter <= e (or start your counter at 0), your code is absolutely perfect.

Really impressive progress overall. Keep it up!

Neat, readable code. Variable names like mul and minValue show you understand what each does, and the loops stop at the right bounds. Product, Fibonacci and divisor count all behave properly. HTML rowspan, anchor-to-section and the disc bullet list are accurate. Keep up this standard.

Strong C section: clean loops and the full leap year condition. Registration form and video player are fully correct. Only the nested list lost marks because Hardware and Software were put at the same level as Computer; they must sit in an inner ul inside the Computer li.

Several loop errors. Sum loop stops at j<n and drops the last number. Factorial starts at 0, so the result stays 0; it should start at 1. Prime check using n%2 only tests odd, which is wrong for 9 or 15. Even/odd and maximum are good. In HTML the image must be inside the anchor, and the table needs th headings.

Not much of the C section works. Sum was left blank, even/odd tests n>0, factorial starts at 0, maximum ignores c, and prime uses n%2 only. These are basic condition and initial-value errors, so please revise loops and if-else. On the positive side, all three HTML answers are completely correct.

Good C answers except Fibonacci, where the loop uses <=n and overshoots by one term. The rowspan attribute is missing in the employee table. The bookmark link points to #contact but the section id is contacts, so the link breaks. Check ids carefully. Disc list is correct.

Sum of squares and the double-based average are well done, and Armstrong with cubes is correct. Leap year misses the century rule (divisible by 100 but not 400). Reverse does not accumulate digits, check rev*10 logic. Registration form and nested list are right, but the video element lacks controls, so users cannot play it.

Solid work on the basic C loops and HTML forms, but a few logic errors cost you points. For Task 3, use rev = rev * 10 + n1 % 10; to properly build the reversed number; for Task 4, add parentheses (a+b+c)/3.0 to respect the order of operations; and for Task 5, cube the digits (d*d*d) instead of squaring them. Finally, always try to manage your time so you don't leave questions completely blank (like HTML Task 3).

Excellent submission. Loops, long long for the product and the Fibonacci shifting are all clean and match the spec exactly. Only small remark: zero prints Negative, so think about whether a zero case needs its own message. HTML table rowspan, bookmark link and disc list are all correct.

Very solid work, all five C programs are logical and tidy. Power with long long and the palindrome reverse-and-compare are exactly what I wanted. Only slip is the timetable heading: it needs colspan to span both columns. Image gallery and nav bar are good.

Your Sum of Squares adds i instead of i*i, so the series is wrong from N=2. Leap year only checks %4 and ignores the century rule (1900 fails). Reverse never accumulates digits: rev=rev*10+n%10 is needed. Armstrong uses d*d but must cube. Task 4 is blank. Good: forms and video are correct, but the nested list was flattened into one ul.

The image is outside the anchor so it is not clickable, and the ordered list needs bold formatting. Marks table is correct.

Leap year is perfect, including the 400/100 rule, nice. Reverse is broken: rev=num%10 overwrites instead of rev=rev*10+num%10. Average prints a+b+c/3 because of operator precedence, so brackets are needed. Armstrong squares digits instead of cubing. Task 1 left empty. item_title: Post-Test MCQ 1: HTML Line Break Tag
item_question: এইচটিএমএল (HTML) ডকুমেন্টে নতুন লাইন বা লাইন ব্রেক তৈরি করার জন্য কোন ট্যাগটি ব্যবহৃত হয়? (Line break tag in HTML).
teacher_comment: Correct key is the br tag. The break option is a harmless invented distractor, while p and hr are real tags that a careless student might pick. Syllabus fit is good. The Bangla stem is okay, but it is a plain recall question with low difficulty for this level.

item_title: Pre-Test MCQ 7: SQL Data Retrieval Command
item_question: এসকিউএল (SQL)-এ ডাটাবেজ টেবিল থেকে নির্দিষ্ট ডেটা খুঁজে বের করার বা প্রদর্শনের জন্য কোন কমান্ডটি ব্যবহৃত হয়? (SQL command for data retrieval).
teacher_comment: SELECT is the textbook answer for retrieving data and the distractors (GET, OPEN, EXTRACT) are not SQL keywords, so there is no ambiguity. Fits Chapter 6 exactly. Honestly it is quite easy for class 11-12, but acceptable for a pre-test warm-up.

item_title: Transfer Task 3: Reverse of an Integer Digits
item_question: একটি সি (C) প্রোগ্রাম লিখুন যা কোনো প্রদত্ত পূর্ণসংখ্যার অংকগুলো বিপরীতক্রমে (Reversed Order) সাজিয়ে প্রদর্শন করবে। (Reverse digits of an integer). ইনপুট: একটি ধনাত্মক পূর্ণসংখ্যা N। আউটপুট: ঠিক এই ফরম্যাটে একটিমাত্র লাইন — N = 1234 হলে Reverse = 4321। কোনো প্রম্পট প্রিন্ট করা যাবে না। (Input: one positive integer N. Output exactly one line: Reverse = 4321 when N = 1234. Print no prompt text.)
teacher_comment: Good transfer problem on loops with modulus and division. Output format is strictly given, so auto-checking is fair. I would add a note about numbers ending in zero (like 1200), because the expected output for those is not stated. Medium difficulty, suitable for HSC.

item_title: Transfer MCQ 4: Title Tag Purpose

teacher_comment: Title content shows on the browser tab or title bar, so C is right. Option A looks tempting to students who confuse it with search engine results, which gives the question some discriminating power. Wording is fine, though the phrase 'title bar' is slightly old-fashioned for modern browsers.

item_title: Withdrawal HTML Task 1: Class Routine Timetable
item_question: হেডার কলামে colspan="2" ব্যবহার করে ক্লাসের রুটিনের একটি সমন্বিত এইচটিএমএল টেবিল তৈরি করুন। (Class routine table with colspan). টেবিলে অন্তত ২টি সারি (<tr>) রাখুন — প্রথম সারিতে <th> হেডার সেল যার একটিতে colspan="2", এবং পরের সারিতে অন্তত ২টি <td> ঘরে বিষয়ের নাম। (At least 2 rows: a header row of <th> cells with one carrying colspan="2", and a data row with at least 2 <td> cells.)
teacher_comment: Task fits the table chapter well and the rubric (th with colspan=2, then a data row with two td) is clear to check. I feel the Bangla word 'সমন্বিত' is vague, and it is not said whether the data row must have exactly two cells. Slight tightening would make the answer fully defensible.

item_title: Withdrawal MCQ 7: SQL DELETE vs DROP Distinction
item_question: ডাটাবেজ টেবিল স্ট্রাকচার অপরিবর্তিত রেখে শুধুমাত্র ভিতরের সমস্ত রেকর্ড মুছে ফেলতে কোন SQL কমান্ড ব্যবহৃত হয়? (SQL DELETE vs DROP).
teacher_comment: Strong conceptual question: DELETE FROM clears rows but keeps the structure, DROP TABLE removes the table itself. This is a typical confusion point for students, so the difficulty is right. Only note: TRUNCATE also does the job but is not listed, so no conflict with the key.

qualitative_feedback: Sum and reverse are correct and video is good. Leap year ignores 100/400, average misses brackets, Armstrong squares instead of cubing. The form needs for and name attributes. The nested list was written flat, Hardware and Software must be inside an inner ul.

Factorial and maximum with proper comparisons are good, and even/odd is right. Sum loop stops at j<num and misses the last number. Prime check using num%2 only tells odd, so 9 would be called prime. The table and image link are correct, but the formatted ordered list was not attempted.

Neat, correct loops, long long product and the shifting Fibonacci are all well handled. Divisor counting is good. The bookmark link breaks because href is #contact but your section id is contacts, so always match ids exactly. Rowspan table and disc list are fine.

Very good paper. All five C programs are logical and cleanly written, the Armstrong cube and double average are spot on. Your video and nested list are right too. Only the registration form lost marks: the label needs a for attribute and the input needs name="name".

Product, minimum and the disc list are accurate. Fibonacci loops one extra time and positive check uses >1. Divisor counting was left blank. The bookmark section id is contacts but link says #contact. Rowspan table is right.

Sum of odd numbers adds every number instead of stepping by 2. GPA uses > rather than >=. Swap assigns a=b first and loses the original value. Routine table needs colspan="2" in the heading. Second image misses alt text. Power and nav bar are right, palindrome is correct.
Even/odd, maximum and the HTML answers are good. Sum loop uses j<n and skips N; factorial starts at 0; prime check is only an odd test. Fix loop end conditions and initial values.

C programs are all correct and the swap with temp is neat. The GPA uses > instead of >=, so exactly 80 gets A instead of A+. In the navigation bar, Courses is plain text without a link, so the menu is incomplete. Table and gallery are good.

Sum, factorial and the square-root prime test are well done. Even/odd uses n>0, which has nothing to do with parity, use n%2==0. Maximum never compares c. In HTML the marks table should use th cells for headings. Image link and bold ordered list are correct.

Several basic errors: product starts at 0, positive check uses >1 so 1 is called Negative, Fibonacci overshoots with <=, and minimum ignores c. Divisor count, rowspan table and disc list are correct. The bookmark target id (contacts) does not match #contact. Please practise initial values and boundaries.

Good work: seven of eight tasks are correct and clean, including the full leap year rule and proper reverse. Armstrong was left blank, which cost the most. HTML form, video and nested list are all right. Attempt every question next time.

Palindrome and the GPA conditions are okay in places, but power loop runs e-1 times, so the result is short by one multiplication. The swap does a=b then b=a, so both values are equal; a temp variable is needed. The palindrome reverse overwrites digits. Second gallery image has no alt text. Routine table and nav are fine.

Strong submission. Leap year with the full condition, reverse with rev*10 and cubed Armstrong are accurate. The average prints a+b+c/3, so division only touches c; use brackets. The video has no controls attribute, so a visitor cannot press play. Form and nested list are correct.

Sum of odd, GPA and swap are correct. Power was not attempted and the gallery is blank. Palindrome overwrites digits instead of rev*10+digit. Heading needs colspan="2". Navigation bar has Courses as text without anchor. Please attempt all tasks.

Sum, even/odd, maximum and prime are correct. Factorial starts at 0 so every result is 0. The marks table needs th header cells. The clickable image task was not answered. Ordered list with bold is right.

Positive/negative, Fibonacci and minimum are properly done, and rowspan, bookmark and list in HTML are correct. Product begins at 0, so output is always 0, and divisor loop uses counter<num, so the number itself is not counted. Small initial-value and boundary slips.

Weak paper. Sum loop adds every number (squares/series logic mismatched), leap year ignores century rule, average lacks brackets, Armstrong squares digits. Reverse and nested list were not attempted. Form and video lose marks for missing for/name and controls. Revise basic loops and operator precedence.

Sum, even/odd and the marks table with th are fine and the bold list is right. Factorial starts at 0, maximum ignores c, prime check was blank. The image should sit inside the anchor tag so it is clickable; yours is outside the link.

Product starts at 0 and the positive check uses n>1, both basic boundary mistakes. Fibonacci and minimum were left blank. Divisor count, bookmark link and bullet list are correct. The employee table lacks rowspan. Try to attempt every question, even partly.

Needs a lot of revision. Sum stops one short, even/odd tests n>0, maximum is blank and prime is only odd. Factorial and ordered list are right. Table lacks th cells and the image is outside the anchor. Review loops and conditions.

Product starts at p=0, so it always prints 0; start at 1. Fibonacci loops one time too many (j<=number). Positive/negative, minimum and divisor count are correct. Table lacks rowspan and the bullet list lacks type=disc. Bookmark link is correct.

Sum of squares is good and all three HTML answers, including the nested list, are fully correct. In C though: leap year ignores the 100/400 rule; reverse never builds the number; average needs brackets (a+b+c)/3; Armstrong must cube digits. Revise operator precedence and accumulation.
Almost perfect. Everything works except maximum, where c is never compared, so a larger third number is missed. Sum, factorial, prime and all HTML are correct and nicely formatted.
